info.title: Wraps Platform API
info.description:
REST API for the Wraps email marketing platform. Send emails, manage contacts, trigger workflows, and process events.

**Errors.** Every 4xx and 5xx response returns the `ApiError` object: branch on the stable `code`, show `error` to a person, quote `requestId` to support. The full list of codes is enumerated on the schema.

**Rate limits.** Limited responses carry `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining`, `RateLimit-Reset` (seconds, not a timestamp) and `RateLimit-Policy`, plus `Retry-After` on a 429. See https://wraps.dev/docs/reference/rate-limits

**Versioning.** Breaking changes ship as a new version; deprecations are announced with `Deprecation` and `Sunset` headers and a 6-month minimum notice. Policy: https://wraps.dev/docs/reference/versioning

post.summary: Re-probe one account's console-access policy version
post.description: Assumes the account's wraps-console-access-role and probes which version of the Wraps console policy it carries, then persists the reading. Exists so a customer who has just repaired their role sees it reflected immediately rather than waiting for the hourly sweep, which does not re-probe an account it checked within the last day. Rate limited to one probe per account per minute; inside that window, or when SES throttles the probe, the stored reading is returned with `rechecked: false`.

get.description: Returns the SES health verdict the hourly account-health sweep last persisted for every AWS account connected to this organization, plus the org-wide rollup (worst status wins; `unknown` outranks `healthy`). Zero AWS calls — this is Postgres-only, bounded by the freshness of the last hourly sweep (`checkedAt`).

get.description: Lists SES sending identities (domains and email addresses) across the organization's connected AWS accounts, read live from SES. An account whose console-access role cannot be assumed is reported unreachable in `accounts` rather than failing the whole request.

get.description: Returns aggregate email metrics for the organization, optionally grouped by period/domain/broadcast/template/source/account/region. `opened` excludes user agents matching a known-bot list; `openedRaw` reports the same count with no bot filter applied; `clicked` is currently unfiltered (see plan 107 for this asymmetry). `costUsd` is an estimate from published AWS SES rates, not a billed amount. It covers outbound sending only (billable means non-failed sends), tiered by UTC calendar month at each account's current SES pricing plan and spread as the account's average per-email cost for that month. `null` means the cost is unknown (no recorded plan or no account). Figures for the current month can shift as month-to-date volume grows.

bearerAuth.description: API key (wraps_*) or session token. Use format: Bearer wraps_your_api_key

ApiError.description: Returned by every 4xx and 5xx response. Branch on `code`, show `error`, quote `requestId` to support.

error.description: Human-readable message. Wording may change; do not parse it.
examples: AWS account does not belong to this organization

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Safe to branch on across releases.

requestId.description: Correlates with the `x-request-id` response header and with server logs.

BadRequest.description: Malformed request — unparseable body or an invalid parameter.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, malformed, or revoked credentials. Send `Authorization: Bearer <api key>`.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated, but the resource belongs to another organization.

NotFound.description: No such route, or no such resource in this organization.

ValidationFailed.description: The request parsed but failed schema validation.

RateLimited.description: Rate limit exceeded. Wait for the window named by the RateLimit headers.

RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests permitted in the window closest to exhaustion.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests still available in that window.

RateLimit-Policy.description: Every policy in force, as "<limit>;w=<window seconds>", comma-separated.

InternalError.description: Unexpected server failure. Safe to retry with backoff; quote `requestId` if it persists.
